# Blink Frame Photography — Full Studio Knowledgebase

## 1. Studio Identity & Overview
Blink Frame Photography is an award-winning photography and cinematic filmmaking studio headquartered in Kolkata and Hooghly, West Bengal, India.
- Domain: https://blinkframephotography.in
- WhatsApp: +91 70018 70391
- Phone: +91 86175 63429
- Email: blinkframephotography@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Sunday, 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM IST
- Service Region: Kolkata Metropolitan Area, Chandannagar, Hooghly, Howrah, North 24 Parganas, South 24 Parganas, Bardhaman, and destination shoots worldwide.

## 2. Artistic Philosophy
"We Don't Stage Emotions. We Let Them Breathe."
Blink Frame Photography avoids rigid artificial posing in favor of genuine micro-expressions, hearty laughter, spontaneous tears, and true cultural rituals. Every visual is post-processed with calibrated true-to-life film tones, natural skin contrast, and rich shadow detail.

## 3. Detailed Service Packages & Deliverables

### Pre-Wedding Shoot
- Duration: 1 to 2 days
- Locations: Heritage Kolkata ghats, architectural palaces, lush outdoor resorts, or scenic countryside.
- Deliverables:
  - 40+ master retouched high-resolution portraits
  - 1 cinematic 4K video teaser / Instagram Reel (60–90 seconds)
  - Drone aerial 4K footage included
  - Same-week teaser delivery for social announcements

### Rice Ceremony (Annaprashan)
- Specialization: Traditional Bengali first-rice eating ritual for infant boys (6th month) and girls (7th month).
- Rituals Covered: Mama's blessing, silver thali feast, book/money/clay toy selection test, grandfather's aashirwad.
- Deliverables:
  - 250+ edited color-corrected digital images
  - 30+ signature fine-art baby portraits
  - Deluxe archival photobook album (lay-flat matte finish)

### Wedding Photography & Cinematography
- Rituals Covered: Aiburobhat, Gaye Holud, Tatta, Borjatri arrival, Shubho Drishti, Mala Badal, Saat Paake Ghadha, Kanya Daan, Sindoor Daan, and Vidai.
- Cinema Style: Multi-camera 4K Sony Cinema Line (FX3 / A7S III / A7 IV) with G-Master prime lenses, wireless DJI audio, Ronin gimbals.
- Deliverables:
  - 3–5 minute cinematic highlight film
  - 30–45 minute comprehensive traditional documentary video
  - 500+ master processed wedding photos
  - Hardcover flush-mount wedding album with custom wooden box

### Maternity & Baby Shoots
- Safe, comfortable indoor studio and outdoor natural-light sessions.
- Maternity gown styling, intimate couple belly portraits, and safe swaddled newborn milestones.

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: How early should we book our wedding or rice ceremony date?
A: Peak Bengali wedding dates (Aghrahayan, Magh, Falgun, Baishakh) book 6 to 12 months in advance. We recommend contacting us as soon as your date and venue are finalized.

### Q: Do you travel outside Kolkata?
A: Yes. We cover all districts of West Bengal, neighbouring states (Odisha, Bihar, Assam), and destination weddings across India. Travel and stay are arranged collaboratively.

### Q: How long does photo and video editing take?
A: You will receive 15–20 sneak peek images within 48–72 hours after the event. The complete high-resolution photo collection is delivered within 3–4 weeks. Custom cinematic films and photobook albums are finalized within 6–8 weeks.

### Q: How can we confirm our reservation?
A: Contact us on WhatsApp at +91 70018 70391 or via https://blinkframephotography.in/contact.html. A nominal 25% date-blocking advance confirms your schedule.
